Deployment work

The environment was prepared on a Hetzner VPS using Debian 12, followed by FreePBX deployment and PBX administration through the web interface. The project combines Linux-side validation with GUI-based telephony setup, which is important for showing real-world delivery rather than only module-level configuration.

Server verification
Release, hostname, uptime, and Asterisk status were validated from the console.
FreePBX management
Administrative dashboard used for trunk, route, extension, and feature setup.
Business call flow
Inbound and outbound routing configured for practical voice operations.

Technical scope

Trunking

SIP trunk

Configured outbound connectivity through a named trunk with caller ID settings.

Users

PJSIP extensions

Provisioned multiple extensions for internal users visible in the extension list.

Inbound and outbound

Mapped incoming and outgoing call paths through FreePBX routing rules.

Features

Groups and conference

Added ring groups and a conference room for collaboration use cases.
